_note: JSE syntax-completeness wave 2 — declaration & call grammar. Pins: spread in array/object literals (sources: array, string→graphemes, Set→values, Map→entries; object spread merges dict keys last-wins), stored-lambda calls (`const f = x => …; f(2)` — a scope value that IS a lambda is callable; shadows builtins, 32-frame guard shared with user functions), destructuring declarations (`const {a, b: r} = o` / `const [x, y] = arr` — flat patterns, no defaults) and multi-declarators (`let a = 1, b = 2`) in bounded `{ }` blocks, and the `in` operator (dict key / array index membership; relational precedence). Statement-level twins (do…while, for…of over strings/Set/Map + destructured loop vars, ??= &&= ||= sugar) live in the actions corpus.
